scripts.build: npm run build -w @drimvox/web && npm run build -w @drimvox/desktop && npm run build -w @drimvox/server
scripts.start: npm run build && npm run start -w @drimvox/desktop
scripts.dist: npm run build -w @drimvox/web && npm run build -w @drimvox/desktop && npm run dist -w @drimvox/desktop
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run e2e
scripts.server: npm run build -w @drimvox/web && npm run build -w @drimvox/server && node apps/server/dist/server.mjs
